item: An Ollama address on another computer is refused with its reason everywhere the state is reported, and nothing is launched for it
key_paths: src/llm/ollama_lifecycle.py; src/llm/backend.py; src/llm/activation.py; src/llm/arbitration.py; src/llm/ollama.py; src/api/llm.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; tests/test_ollama_stays_on_this_computer.py
summary: is_running and _ollama_available swallowed the loopback refusal, so a remote OO_OLLAMA_URL read as a stopped daemon, can_launch stayed true and Launch spawned a local ollama serve the app never talked to. The shared rule is now said in state(), resolve_backend, activation, arbitration, stop/release and Settings (x12); start() raises it before the binary check or any spawn. A malformed address fails closed with a sentence instead of a ValueError (four endpoints had 500ed), and an address with sign-in details is never quoted. 22 tests with a thread-filtered lookup/connect recorder and a loopback control.
